FEVER. [40] [Bapt.]
Shivering. θ Typhus.
Shivering preceded by a sense of weakness. θ Typhus.
Chilly all day ; whole body feels sore.
Chilly on going into open air ; chills over back and lower limbs ; evening.
Chilly over back while sitting by a fire ; forenoon.
Chilliness alternated with heat. θ Typhus.
Chilliness of lower limbs and back, with fever at night. θ Diphtheria.
Chill followed by fever, with severe aching in muscular portion of body. θ Typhus.
Whole surface hot and dry, with occasional chills, mostly up and down back.
Extremities feel hot, except feet, which are cold.
Flashes of heat from small of back in all directions ; dull, heavy aching, great prostration.
On awaking at 3 A. M., flashes of heat, feeling as if sweat would break out.
Gentle flashes of heat over whole body.
Fever set in with headache. θ Typhus.
General fever and malaise.
Heat of face, flashes over face.
Burning, pungent heat over whole body, especially in face. θ Typhus.
Heat at night ; burning in legs preventing sleep.
Heat of skin. θ Typhus.
Uncomfortable burning all over surface, especially face ; had to move to a cool part of bed, and finally to rise and open a window and wash his face and hands.
Gentle flushes of heat over whole body, followed by a slight perspiration.
Frequent sweats. θ Typhus.
Causes sweat to break out and relieves ; critical sweat on forehead and face. θ Typhus.
Fetid sweat.
Chills, fever and sweat every other afternoon.
Fever cases, with peculiar delirium ; dulness of intellect and abdominal tenderness.
Sensation as if there was a second self outside of patient. θ Typhus.
Fever, delirium, headache, pain in back and limbs ; (compare Rhus). θ Typhus.
General fever and malaise. θ Typhus.
Aspect of low fever. θ Typhus.
Determination of blood to surface and profuse sweating. θ Typhus.
Early stages : white tongue, red edges ; or brown, or yellow brown down centre ; bitter or flat taste ; cannot digest food ; stools frequent, yellow ; gurgling and slight sensitiveness of right iliac region ; pulse high ; fever tends to increase ; parts rested on are sore. θ Typhus.
Typhus and typhoid fever, with a tendency to putrescence.
Fever originating from confinement on shipboard, without good care or food.
Beginning of typhus, when so-called nervous symptoms predominate.
Cerebral forms, especially with excessive drowsiness, delirium, confusion of ideas, stupefying headache ; restless sleep, head feels scattered about ; frightful dreams ; great debility and nervous prostration, with erethism, etc.
Typhoid and cerebral forms of fever ; delirium, drowsiness, confusion, gives slow answer or falls asleep attempting a reply ; erethism ; tries to escape from bed ; sleepless because she cannot get herself together ; head feels scattered, and she tosses about to get pieces together ; sensation of a second self outside of patient ; indifferent ; low delirium, stupor ; sordes on teeth ; face dark, besotted looking ; hearing dull ; epistaxis ; involuntary, scanty stool ; difficult breathing ; fever increases each afternoon.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Bapt.]
Right : pain in temple ; pain behind ear ; pain over ear ; stitches in eye ; running from nostril ; ear sore ; nostril stopped ; pain in mastoid process ; pain in lung ; stitches in tonsil ; iliac region sensitive ; stitches in groin ; stitches in kidney ; pain under scapula ; pain down leg ; pain in elbow ; pain in eye ; pains in hand ; pain in shoulder joint ; pain in little finger ; pain in patella ; burning top of foot ; pain in os calcis ; pain in great toe.
Left : pain over eye ; pain in eye ; eye weak ; stitches in eyes ; pain in orbit ; pain below ear ; pain in parotid gland ; bleeding from nostril ; burning side of face and head ; shooting in kidney ; pain in groin ; pain in testicle ; pain through chest ; stitches in nipple ; pain in shoulder joint ; pain in ulna ; stitches in radius ; numbness of hand and forearm ; pain in waist ; pain in bones of forearm ; pains in hand ; pain in knee and shoulder ; pain in thumb ; stitches under thumb nail ; foot numb ; paralysis of whole side.
Above downward : pain in shoulder.
Below upward : heat in stomach.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Bapt.]
As if there was a second self ; as if scattered about ; as of a band around forehead ; as if temples were pressed by thumbs ; as if top of head would fly off ; as if head was swelling ; as if eyes were pressed into head, as if he had eaten pepper ; as if water had passed through posterior nares ; as of a hard substance in stomach ; as if lying on a board ; as if hair on first phalanx of right great toe was pulled.
Peculiar feeling of brain.
Sharp pain : in temples ; over eyes ; in bowels ; in left groin ; in chest ; in sternum ; in left knee.
Sharp thrusts : over right eye ; in left ulna ; in left thumb.
Darting : in body ; in carpus, metacarpus and phalanges.
Cutting : in bowels.
Hot stitches : in temples.
Stitches : in head ; in upper eyelid ; in right eye ; in left eye like needles ; in right tonsil ; in right groin ; in right kidney ; in sternum ; in left nipple ; in metacarpal bone of left index finger ; in left radius ; under left thumb nail ; in outer hamstring ; in right subscapularis muscle.
Shooting : in bowels ; in left kidney.
Pricking : in pharynx.
Prickling : of left side of face and head ; in left hand and forearm ; of left foot.
Tearing : in right metacarpus ; in right os calcis.
Drawing : in cervical muscles ; along nose ; in right groin and testicle ; in legs and knee joints ; in hips and calves ; in arms and legs.
Fiery pain : when urinating.
Burning : of eyes ; of left side of face and head ; of cheeks ; at root of tongue ; in throat ; in fauces ; in stomach ; at anus ; when urinating ; in muscles of back ; dorsum of r. foot ; in legs ; all over skin.
Soreness : in back of head ; as if in brain ; of eyeballs ; in front of head ; of right ear ; from nose to nares ; of teeth and gums ; of fauces ; of abdominal muscles ; in bowels ; of larynx ; of right lung ; down neck ; about shoulders and chest ; in anterior of thighs.
Pressure : in forehead ; at stomach ; in left testicle.
Aching : in stomach and liver ; in bowels ; in lumbar region ; of back and hips ; in limbs ; from finger ends to toes.
Bruised ache : in head ; in occiput ; in pectoralis minor.
Squeezed pain : in left testicle.
Rheumatic pain : in back ; in left wrist ; in left thumb ; in right middle finger and shoulder joint ; in left knee ; on inner side of right os calcis ; in right and left ulna ; in muscles of posterior part of right thigh ; in metacarpal bone of right index finger ; in right shin bone ; in bones of left wrist and hand ; in left elbow ; in right ankle and heel.
Cramp : at root of nose ; in stomach ; in testes ; in calves.
Colicky pains : in umbilical and hypogastric region.
Griping : in bowels.
Scraped feeling : on tongue ; in throat.
Gnawing : in stomach.
Dull pain : in anterior lobes of brain and frontal sinus ; at root of nose ; in spleen ; at pit of stomach ; in umbilical region ; in left chest ; in sacrum ; in right patella and tarsal bones.
Undefined pain : in right temple ; behind right ear ; in region of supraorbital nerve ; in limbs and small of back ; over l. eye ; below left ear ; in left parotid ; in right mastoid process ; in articulation of jaw ; in right lung ; in root of tongue ; in epigastric region ; in cardiac region of stomach ; in liver ; in gall-bladder ; in spleen ; in abdomen ; in right lung ; through left chest ; under right scapula ; in sacrum ; in l. shoulder ; down arm ; in right elbow ; in metacarpal bone of right little finger ; in lower part of left ulna and tarsus.
Throbbing : in head ; over eyes.
Beating : in forehead.
Fulness : of head ; in stomach.
Heaviness : of head ; over eyes ; in chest ; in whole body.
Weight : in precordial region ; over eyes.
Oppression : in precordial region.
Tightness : of head.
Constricted feeling : in œsophagus ; of diaphragm ; of lungs.
Bloated feeling : of eyes.
Swollen feeling : of head ; of tongue.
Large feeling : of head and hands.
Tired feeling : in neck.
Weak feeling : general ; in chest.
Weakness : in arms and hands ; of lower limbs ; in knees ; of body.
"Gone" feeling : at stomach.
Shocks : in head.
Numbness : of hand ; of face ; of tongue ; of left hand and forearm ; of left foot.
Tickling : in throat.
Heat : in ears ; in forehead ; in face ; in fauces ; in stomach ; in liver ; of the skin.
Dryness : of the skin.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bapt.]
Prostration with disposition of fluids to decompose.
Stiffness of all joints, as though strained ; rheumatic pains and soreness all over body.
Discharges and exhalations fetid ; breath, stools, urine, sweat, ulcers.
Ulceration of mucous membranes, especially those of mouth ; also with tendency to putrescence.
Enlarged glands.
Diseases of mucous membranes.
Derangements of mucous surfaces, generally with vomiting and purging.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Bapt.]
Touch : larynx sore.
Pressure : abdominal muscles sore ; headache > ; pain in mastoid region > ; pain region of supraorbital nerve > ; pain left orbit >.
Pressing on crown of head : pain in left eye <.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bapt.]
Burning all over skin, < in face.
Livid spots over body and limbs, not elevated, of irregular shape, size of a pea up to bean, without any sensation.
Rose-colored spots on 9th day. θ Typhus.
Eruption like measles or urticaria.
Pimples thick on palatine arch, tonsils and uvula ; breath fetid ; salivation ; prostration. θ Variola.
Foul, gangrenous, phagedenic syphilitic sores.
Smallpox confluent, tardy eruption.
Gangrenous sores, aphthæ, sore nipples (locally).
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bapt.]
Lymphatic temperament.
Children : offensive diarrhœa.
Old people : dysentery.
Girl, æt. 7, after being physicked, etc., for a cough ; great prostration, etc.
Old woman, æt. 79 ; Üdema.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Bapt.]
Cognates : Arnic., Arsen., Bryon., Gelsem., (especially in the malaise, nervousness, flushed face or drowsiness, and muscular soreness in early stages) ; Hyosc., Kali chlor., Laches., Mur. ac., Nitr. ac. (in typhoids) ; Nux vom., Opium, Rhus tox.
When. Arsen. has been given in typhus improperly.
Silic., like Baptis., has ability to swallow only liquids, (like milk), but unlike the latter, it has also aversion to milk. See 13.
Terebinth. and Nitr. ac. acted well after Baptis. θ Typhus.
Hamam. speedily checked copious, repeated epistaxis. θ Typhus.
